comment: Smallest sibling of model24chan18cls / model32chan18cls. Symmetric coprime dilation ramp 1,3,5,7,13,19,31,19,13,7,5,3,1 (13 conv layers + final 1x1). RF = 1+2*sum = 255 voxels -> matched to the 256 cube; all rates odd, gcd 1, a dilation=1 layer present, so no gridding holes (Wang et al., WACV 2018). Capacity from depth, not width: peak activation memory stays at channels x 256^3 (one buffer reused per layer) -> 16ch is the lightest/fastest of the deep 18-class family. NO skip/residual connections (anti-U-Net); the deep plain stack relies on per-channel GroupNorm in every block, hence affine=true. Hidden convs are bias-free; only the final 1x1 classifier conv carries a bias. Trained with GELU activations on SynthSeg-style synthetic data (synth18/label18, turbo16 checkpoint).
